assertion_review.fails_if: The three production readers return a wrong model, lane/model-key pair or declaring-lane list; fixed fixture answers are independent expectations.
Any mixed caller bypasses flight.read_layer_file for the catalogue, including restoring ledger's private cached reader.

Layer hand-outs share mutable identity outside a region or allocate separate views inside it; observed object identities are compared with the independently observed call count, not a passed-in expected result.
A regional nested mutation is accepted, or outside-region hand-outs stop being ordinary dict objects.
Restoring uncached layer reads or an independent ledger parse cache makes the instrumented parser run more than once; no real parse also fails the assertion.

The initial readers misresolve the fixture or a rewrite leaves any reader using stale bytes; replacement-model is independently persisted then read through production resolution, so retaining the old cached result makes these assertions fail.
Removing deep-copy hand-out lets the nested poison assignment corrupt later catalogue answers; the recorded declared mutation demonstrably fails line 105.
The initial fixture does not resolve or deleted-file reads retain the cached mapping instead of returning missing-file answers, including an inherited backend model.
